'''Shayziens' Wall''', also known as the '''Shayzien Outpost''', is a wall located west of [[Shayzien]]. Immediately to the west of the wall, on the other side of the river, are two outposts that serve as a first line of defence against the [[lizardmen]]. Fires can be found at both of the outposts.

West of this wall is the [[Lizardman Settlement]], home to hostile lizardmen, including [[Lizardman brute|brutes]] and [[Lizardman shaman|shamans]], who can [[poison]] unprepared players.
